name: Brainiac
summary: A cosmic collector who keeps cities in bottles. Brainiac, an alien intelligence from the planet Colu, bottled Kandor, a city from Krypton, and has haunted Superman ever since.
origin: Brainiac is the villain who treats civilisations like souvenirs, and that's why he's so creepy. Otto Binder and Al Plastino introduced him in Action Comics #242 in 1958 as a green-skinned alien from the planet Colu who cruised the galaxy shrinking cities and keeping them in bottles. His biggest prize was Kandor, a Kryptonian city he stole before the planet exploded, and Superman spent years trying to restore it to full size. Later versions made him a living computer, then a skull-faced robot, then a cold collector of entire worlds. Whatever the body, he has a twelfth-level intellect, can take over machines and ranks among the most dangerous enemies Superman has.
powers: Strong, fast and tough robotic bodies

storyline.title: The city shrinker
storyline.beat: Brainiac debuts in Action Comics #242 as a green-skinned alien who shrinks cities and keeps them in bottles, including Kandor from Krypton.

storyline.title: Robot redesign
storyline.beat: A redesign makes Brainiac a metal robot body with a skull-shaped spaceship, a look that stuck for years.

storyline.title: Invasion
storyline.beat: Brainiac takes over Warworld and invades Earth, and Superman gathers dozens of heroes to stop him.

storyline.title: The collector
storyline.beat: Geoff Johns and Gary Frank recast Brainiac as a cold collector of worlds. In the aftermath, Superman's adoptive father Jonathan Kent dies of a heart attack.

gossip.text: Brainiac started out as a green-skinned alien. In 1964 the comics recast him as a computer built by the machine rulers of his home world, Colu.
Brainiac 5 of the Legion of Super-Heroes is his heroic descendant from the future.
He comes from the planet Colu.
James Marsters played Brainiac in Smallville.

quiz.q: Which Kryptonian city did Brainiac bottle?
Which Legion member is Brainiac's descendant?

timeline.title: City thief
timeline.note: Action Comics #242 introduces a green-skinned alien who shrinks and steals cities, including Kandor.

timeline.title: Robot reveal
timeline.note: Superman #167 recasts Brainiac as a computer built by the people of Colu.

timeline.title: Skull-ship upgrade
timeline.note: Action Comics #544 rebuilds him as a chrome robot with a skull-shaped starship.

timeline.title: Stolen Memories
timeline.note: Superman: The Animated Series makes Brainiac the AI that let Krypton die to save itself.

timeline.title: Superman: Brainiac
timeline.note: Geoff Johns and Gary Frank reveal the real Brainiac hiding behind all the drones.

timeline.title: Krypton
timeline.note: Blake Ritson plays a menacing, city-collecting Brainiac on the Syfy series Krypton.
